All Corn: Free DP for the first 15 days after delivery. If not priced by that date, DP charges of $.06/bu/mo retroactive from date of delivery until 8/20/2027. Any unpriced bushels at that time will be priced out at the close of 8/20/2027.
All Soybeans: Free DP for the first 15 days after delivery. If not priced by that date, DP charges of $.07/bu/mo retroactive from date of delivery until 8/20/2027. Any unpriced bushels at that time will be priced out at the close of 8/20/2027.
All Wheat: Free DP for the first 15 days after delivery. If not priced by that date, DP charges of $.06/bu/mo prorated per day until 7/30/2027. Any bushels that are unpriced or do not have a basis set on by 7/30/2027 will be priced at the end of trade that day.
REMINDER: Since the title of grain passes to the elevator upon application to a DP contract; LDP's cannot be taken at a later date if they become available.
|
|
James Valley Grain will not take delivery of corn containing Durcade traits developed by Syngenta. If testing is required for unacceptable GMO varieties, all costs will be passed onto the producer. Please call if you have any questions. Thanks! |

New Crop Charges
As of 01/01/26 we will not be charging for 2026 Crop HTA contracts.
2027 crop will assess HTA fees. $.08/bu for wheat, $0.10/bu for soybeans and $0.05/bu for corn.
It is nonrefundable and will be taken off the Futures Price at time of contract.
